errors.text_span: OneR QA method for HotpotQA and 2WikiMQA question sources
errors.evidence: The description claims the shortest bars (value 5) correspond to the OneR QA method for HotpotQA and 2WikiMQA. The chart shows the bar with value 5 is for the IRCoT QA method for HotpotQA. The OneR QA bars for HotpotQA and 2WikiMQA have values of 10 and 23, respectively.
The description states that the tallest bar (value 29) corresponds to the HotpotQA question source. The chart shows this bar is in the 2WikiMQA group.
The description states the value for the OneR QA method for MuSiQue was 23, but the chart shows this value is 27.
The description claims a value of 15 for the IRCot QA method, but no bar for IRCot QA has this value. The values for IRCot QA are 5, 14, 23, and 11.
The description states the value for the NoR QA method for 2WikiMQA is 28, but the chart shows a value of 29.
The description states the value for the NoR QA method for IIRC is 14, but the chart shows a value of 15.
The description states that the OneR QA method for IIRC had a value of 11, but the chart shows this value is 14.

This phrase represents a comparison and an interpretation, which the prompt instructs to avoid. Furthermore, the claim is factually incorrect; the lowest value on the chart is 5, not the value for OneR QA for IIRC (which is 14).
